reasoning: The question asks if tech layoffs in 2026 exceed 2025. The market resolves YES if information sector layoffs exceed 447,000 in 2026. Evidence shows Layoffs.fyi tracked ~125,000-126,000 layoffs by mid-August 2026, surpassing 2025's 122,606. However, this tracker covers only tracked companies. TrueUp reported 175,000+ by mid-year. Challenger, Gray & Christmas cited 116,000+ AI-attributed layoffs through August. These figures are substantially below the 447,000 threshold. The evidence indicates 2026 layoffs are modestly higher than 2025 (~2-3% more by tracked metrics), but nowhere near 447,000. Given we're at October 9, 2026 with ~4 months remaining, reaching 447,000 total would require ~321,000 more layoffs in Q4—a dramatic acceleration unsupported by recent trends showing slowdown in June-August.
